messages:
Marie Chen: Heads-up: Finexus security team emailed a consolidated ask. They want RBAC export, KMS rotation evidence (tenant + platform/HSM), and proof of audit log delivery to their SIEM. Retention expectation = 7 years.
Alex Martinez: paste the exact asks? so we can map outputs to their questionnaire fields.
Marie Chen: quote: "Provide role->resource mapping with change history, KMS rotation artifacts for last 12 months (who/when/key-version), and end-to-end audit pipeline (format, retention, redaction). Include on-prem HSM handling and tamper-evidence for hosted keys."
Jamal Price: short answer: we can produce a timestamped RBAC CSV + ACL diffs, signed HSM export (vendor CSV + SHA256 manifest), and CloudAudit slices for hosted KMS.
Grace Li: running checklist: 1) RBAC export command and sample 2) KMS rotation proof with query snippets 3) SIEM sample events (CEF + JSON) 4) redaction approach doc 5) incident timeline template.
Alex Martinez: retention detail: they explicitly expect 7y cold archival, 90d hot. SIEM format preference: CEF or JSONL. Also they want PII redacted from attachments.
Marie Chen: confirmed. For redaction policy we should describe pseudonymization and provide example mapping approach (e.g., pseudonym_id = HMAC(email, internal_key)) but do NOT give HMACs.
sec-bot: task created: Finexus package -> /playbooks/finexus-onboard-1724123456. Owner: Marie. Due: 2025-04-03.
Jamal Price: for HSM evidence: ask vendor for audit export + TPM-backed signature on manifest. We'll include an example signed manifest file and verification instructions. For cloud KMS proof: sample gcloud logging query and JSONL export.
Grace Li: example hosted audit query: 
```
redwoodctl logs query --resource-type kms_key --filter 'methodName:UpdateCryptoKeyVersion' --from 2024-04-01 --to 2025-03-31 --format jsonl > finexus_kms_rotate_2025.jsonl
```
Alex Martinez: RBAC export header suggestion: role,principal,prefix_resource,grant_ts,granted_by,grant_pr_id. Provide a tiny redacted sample (5 rows).
Marie Chen: add a line about ephemeral creds and service account rotation events. They want evidence of short-lived token issuance and revocation where applicable.
Jamal Price: we can surface STS/token audit events and IAM key rotations. Include sample audit entry showing token creation and token revocation with request_id.
Grace Li: SIEM sample: I'll create 1 CEF event and 1 JSON event. Fields: timestamp, actor, action, resource, request_id, auth_method. Keep emails redacted to user:#####.
Alex Martinez: regarding tamper-evidence for hosted: we have object lock/GCS retention + signed manifests. We'll describe the chain: audit logs -> weekly manifest (SHA256) -> manifest signed by internal KMS key -> store signed manifest in archival bucket with retention. Include verification steps.
Marie Chen: Ops approval needed for demo rotation offer. We'll propose a controlled validation where we perform a test rotation in a dev tenant and stream logs to Finexus SIEM. Ops: need your sign-off. @Ops Bot any blockers?
Ops Bot: No blockers noted. Please file runbook and notify 48h before demo.
Jamal Price: include a small forensic play for suspected key compromise: list of artifacts we can supply (audit slices, network flows, key-usage histogram, KV-cache TTLs) and expected RTO for rotation (platform keys: ~30min planned, tenant keys: ~10-15min).
Grace Li: drafting IR timeline: detection -> containment -> rotate -> validate -> notify. Will add example timestamps and command outputs for each step.
Alex Martinez: one more: customer asked for access control change history. We should provide ACL diffs and the ticket references for approvals (where available). If missing, note manual review steps.
Marie Chen: action items: Grace = assemble runbook + SIEM samples + IR timeline (EOD Fri). Jamal = HSM export + signed manifest + hosted audit slices (EOD Fri). Alex = RBAC CSV + diffs + redaction appendix (Mon). I'll compile the package and send to Finexus Tue morning.
sec-bot: reminder set for 2025-04-07 to follow up.
Marie Chen: thanks team. Keep communications short in package, include a one-page summary and attach the supporting artifacts. :thumbsup:
